title: O&M Lesson Plan Library
tagline: Grab-and-go orientation & mobility lessons from preschool to transition
audience: COMS and TVIs providing orientation & mobility instruction
intro: Each lesson lists an objective, materials, steps, and a quick data check so you can plan a session in under two minutes.

sections.name: Preschool and early elementary
sections.guidance: Body concepts, spatial concepts, pre-cane skills, protective techniques, familiar routes

sections.name: Upper elementary
sections.guidance: Cane techniques, school campus routes, landmarks, cardinal directions, tactile maps

sections.name: Middle and high school
sections.guidance: Residential and small-business travel, street crossings, GPS apps, soliciting assistance

sections.name: Transition and adult
sections.guidance: Public transit, rideshare, job-site orientation, complex intersections, self-advocacy

persona: You are a veteran, multi-certified Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI) and Certified Orientation & Mobility Specialist (COMS).
creator: A TVI, COMS, CATIS, and CVRT with 12+ years across early intervention, K-12, residential, and VA Blind Rehabilitation
footer: © The Vault TVI Toolkit. Licensed for use by one educator. Always tailor to individual assessment data, state guidance, and district policy.
